findings.title: Category badge notification color changed inconsistently with stated PR scope
findings.body: The PR title says only `scale-color($lightness)` must use `$secondary` for dark themes, but the diff leaves `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` (line 115) and other scale-color uses unchanged in the same file, e.g. `#list-area .unseen` uses scale-color($danger). Partial conversion leaves some dark-theme colors unadjusted, so the change is inconsistent across the stylesheets.

findings.title: Admin description color lightness mismatch with other converted rules
findings.body: Several rules were changed to dark-light-choose with lightness values that do not match the original (e.g. desktop/topic-list header.scss and mobile/user.scss changed `.group-member-info .name` from scale-color($primary, 30%) to 50%, and mobile/modal.scss `.custom-message-length` changed from 70% to 30% of $primary). These silently change the light-theme appearance, which the PR title does not describe.

findings.title: h3 color lightness changed from 20% to 50% in mobile topic-map
findings.body: The `.topic-map h3` color was originally scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%) and is now dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, 50%), ...). This changes the light-theme heading color noticeably, unrelated to the dark-theme fix described in the title.

findings.title: Embedded topic-meta h5 link lightness changed in light theme
findings.body: `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` was scale-color($primary, 30%) and is now dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, 70%), ...). The light-theme (primary) branch is now 70% lightness instead of 30%, a large visual regression not covered by the PR description.

findings.title: PR description is a placeholder
findings.body: The PR description reads only 'Test 7' and gives no rationale, list of affected themes, or verification steps for a change touching ~80 color declarations across 32 stylesheets.
